versions.content: function GetFileInfo [SWS_PER_00438] Upstream: RS_PER_00004 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < FileInfo > GetFileInfo ( ara::core::StringView file Name) const noexcept; Returns additional information on a file of this File Storage. The returned FileInfo struct contains information about the times when the file was created, last modified, and last accessed, and about how and by whom the file was created and last modified. The modificationTime, accessTime, and fileModificationState returned in the FileInfo are only accurate if the file is currently not open.
